idea-plugin.name: Rubber Duck Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
A rubber duck floats in the corner of your editor and reacts with its "face" to the state of your project — it breathes while you work, panics on a failed build, cheers up on a clean one, and quietly nods when you tell it what's wrong.

This is rubber-duck debugging, made literal: explaining the problem out loud is what helps. The duck never reads, analyses, or answers what you type — that's the whole point. Zero usefulness, maximum delight.

How to use
  • Open a file — the duck appears in the editor corner and breathes.
  • Build with errors → it panics; a clean build → it's happy.
  • Press Ctrl+Alt+D (or click the duck) → tell it what's wrong; it nods.
It never sends anything anywhere, and it has no settings to fiddle with.
